# Jeremiah 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Righteous [are] You, YHWH, when I-plead with-You; yet judgments I-would-speak with-You: Why does-[the]-way-of [the]-wicked prosper? [Why] are-at-ease all treacherous-[ones] dealing-treacherously?

**2** You-planted-them, also they-took-root; they-go, also they-bear-fruit. Near [are] You in-their-mouth but-far from-their-kidneys.

**3** But-You, YHWH, know-me; You-see-me and-test my-heart toward-You. Pull-them-out like-sheep for-[the]-slaughter and-set-them-apart for-[the]-day-of killing.

**4** How-long will the-land mourn and-[the]-herb-of every field wither? From-[the]-evil-of [the]-dwellers in-it, beasts and-birds are-swept-away; for they-said, "He-will-not-see our-latter-end."

**5** "If with foot-soldiers you-ran and-they-wearied-you, then-how will-you-compete with horses? And-in-[the]-land-of peace you-are-trusting, but-how will-you-do in-[the]-thicket-of the-Jordan?

**6** For even your-brothers and-the-house-of your-father, even they have-dealt-treacherously with-you; even they have-called after-you a-full-[cry]. Do-not-believe them when they-speak to-you good-things.

**7** I-have-forsaken My-house; I-have-abandoned My-inheritance; I-have-given the-beloved-of My-soul into-the-hand-of her-enemies.

**8** My-inheritance has-become to-Me like-a-lion in-the-forest; she-gave upon-Me her-voice — therefore I-hated-her.

**9** Is-[not] My-inheritance to-Me a-bird-of-prey [with] hyenas around-her? Go, gather all [the]-beasts-of the-field; bring-them to-devour.

**10** Many shepherds have-destroyed My-vineyard; they-have-trampled My-portion; they-have-made My-pleasant-portion into-a-desolate wilderness.

**11** He-has-made-it a-desolation; desolate it-mourns before-Me. All the-land is-made-desolate, for no man takes-[it]-to heart.

**12** Upon all [the]-bare-heights in-the-wilderness destroyers have-come, for a-sword-of YHWH devours from-one-end-of [the]-land to-the-other-end-of the-land; no peace for-any flesh.

**13** They-sowed wheat and-reaped thorns; they-exhausted-themselves [but]-did-not-profit. And-be-ashamed of-your-harvests from-the-burning anger-of YHWH.

**14** Thus says YHWH against all My-evil neighbors who-touch the-inheritance which I-caused My-people Israel to-inherit: "Behold-Me uprooting-them from-upon their-land, and-[the]-house-of Judah I-will-uproot from-their-midst.

**15** And-it-shall-be after My-uprooting-them, I-will-return and-have-compassion-on-them, and-I-will-bring-them-back, each to-his-inheritance and-each to-his-land.

**16** And-it-shall-be, if they-will-truly-learn the-ways-of My-people, to-swear by-My-name, 'As-YHWH-lives,' as they-taught My-people to-swear by-Baal, then-they-shall-be-built-up in-the-midst-of My-people.

**17** But-if they-will-not listen, then-I-will-uproot that nation, uprooting and-destroying," declares YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **12:1**: Tzaddiq attah YHWH — 'Righteous are You, YHWH.' Jeremiah's complaint follows the form of a legal proceeding (riv). The prophet acts as plaintiff questioning God's justice.

- **12:5**: The 'thicket of the Jordan' (ge'on ha-Yarden) refers to the dense growth along the riverbanks where lions lurked (cf. 49:19). A metaphor for escalating difficulty.

- **12:9**: Ayit tzavua — possibly 'speckled bird of prey.' The image suggests Israel looks foreign among the nations, attracting hostile attention.

— EMET
